data.name: Zoomalia
data.detailed_description:
Monster collecting meets strategic 4x roguelite adventure.

An alien race known as the Zealotory has invaded Zoomalia, drawn by the vast resources beneath its surface. Their towering obelisks corrupt the land, draining its life and controlling the minds of its creatures to defend them.

But not all is lost.

Tame, fuse, and evolve the very creatures they’ve enslaved. Break their control, destroy the obelisks, and bring life back to Zoomalia.

Over 100 unique creatures roam Zoomalia each with their own abilities, traits, evolutions, and rare shiny variants.

Win them over with treats, then fuse, evolve, mutate, and prestige them into your own powerful and unique creature.
Experiment with wild combinations and build a team that’s uniquely yours.

The Zealotory’s obelisks twist the minds of the natural inhabitants of Zoomalia.

Creatures become hostile. The land becomes brittle and lifeless.
Expand your control around each obelisk to weaken and destroy them, defeat the Zealotory with your unique team of creatures to bring life back to Zoomalia.

Every map is completely different.

Explore infinitely possible procedurally generated regions filled with narrative encounters, events, trade outposts, and powerful enemies.
Adapt your strategy, manage your team, and take down unique mini-bosses guarding zones in strategic locations.

  • 100+ collectible creatures with unique abilities and evolutions (Yes evolutions change appearence)

  • Fuse, mutate, and prestige your team to create powerful combinations

  • Tame creatures using treats!

  • Strategic, turn-based battles with deep build variety

  • Procedurally generated strategy maps and roguelite progression

  • Unique mini-bosses and a final boss to defeat

  • Shiny variants, hidden trophies, and permanent upgrades

  • Endless replayability with a unique roguelike endless mode

  • Steam leaderboards for endless mode

data.short_description: In a world conquered by Zealotory harvesters, Zoomalia’s survival rests in your hands. Build a team of over 100 unique creatures, then fuse, evolve, and mutate them into powerful forms. Adapt your strategy, destroy obelisks, and reclaim the planet in this strategic roguelite.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:

  • Processor: Intel Core i5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVidia 970 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
  • Sound Card: No Recommendation

Recommended:

  • Processor: Intel Core i7 or better
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVidia 2060 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 12 GB available space
  • Sound Card: No Recommendation
